 Search Ahn Hyo-seop Makes History at Kids’ Choice Awards as ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Star Leads ‘Final Table’
 riya siddacharjee 8 hours ago 2 min read Ahn Hyo-seop is giving everyone plenty of reasons to talk about him lately! The actor is enjoying a major career moment, with a hit Netflix animated film, a big international award, and a new drama keeping him in the spotlight. 
 Ahn Hyo-seop celebrates international recognition for KPop Demon Hunters while starring as Kang Han in Final Table . From lending his voice to Jin-woo in KPop Demon Hunters to playing a talented chef in JTBC's Final Table , Ahn is showing that he can do a little bit of everything. And honestly, his latest achievements are pretty impressive! 
 Ahn Hyo-seop Makes History at the Kids' Choice Awards 
 One of the biggest highlights of Ahn Hyo-seop's year came on November 14, when he won Favorite Male Animated Voice Actor in a Movie at the 2026 Kids' Choice Awards for his role as Jin-woo in Netflix's KPop Demon Hunters . 
 With the win, Ahn became the first Korean actor to take home the award. He also beat some pretty familiar Hollywood names, including Michael B. Jordan, Tom Hanks, Jack Black, and Chris Pratt. That's quite a lineup to beat! 
 The achievement adds another exciting milestone to his growing international career and puts a spotlight on his work beyond live-action dramas. 
 From Animated Star to a Genius Chef in Final Table 
 While his animated character is winning hearts overseas, Ahn is also keeping viewers hooked with his performance in JTBC's weekend drama Final Table . He plays Kang Han, a talented chef competing in a high-stakes cooking contest while dealing with some difficult personal challenges. 
 His character lost 70% of his sense of smell following a childhood accident and also lives with myasthenia gravis. Despite these struggles, Kang Han continues to push forward in the competition. 
 The drama gives Ahn plenty of room to show different sides of his acting, from his strict chef attitude to his softer moments as a mentor to Song-i, played by Hong Hwa-yeon . His complicated rivalry with Cha Woo-jin, played by Chang Ryul , adds another layer to the story. 
 Ahn has also enjoyed success with SBS drama Sold Out Today Again , which topped Netflix's Global Non-English TV chart and stayed in the top 10 for seven consecutive weeks. His collaboration with Khalid, "Something Special," has also made its mark on US music charts. 
 With Final Table entering its second half, Ahn Hyo-seop clearly has plenty more to show. And if this year is anything to go by, he's only getting started!
